mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the irises was most worthwhile because the ray diagram brought the corneas, lenses, pupils and retinas together into a clear account of how light reaches the sensors.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three front parts became somewhat repetitive, although the named slots made the choices clear and each result added a useful detail.

surprise.text: The contrast between light entering the eye and nerve signals leaving it sharpened my understanding of what the visual pathway carries.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the slots and descriptions gave each fitting a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it similarly connects the assembled parts to a concrete action. The eye movement and final scene made the construction feel purposeful, though the repeated fittings were less engaging.
